summary: Ondas Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the September 14, 2026 closing of its acquisition of 100% of Gate Technologies Ltd. (Israel) and Bron Technologies sp. z.o.o (Poland) under a Share Purchase Agreement with the selling shareholders. Consideration comprised $105.0 million cash plus 10,689,655 common shares, a $25 million working capital adjustment, roughly $22.5 million payable in stock within nine months subject to post-closing obligations, and up to $185 million of two-year stock-settled earn-outs tied to milestones. A Registration Rights Agreement imposes daily sales caps of 15% of average daily volume, limiting shareholder overhang. Watch earn-out milestone disclosure and registration-driven selling pressure.
